title: Wyoming Statutes, Title 42 - Welfare, Chapter 2 - Public Assistance and Social Services, Article 1 - In General
source_id: Wyo. Stat. Ann. tit. 42, ch. 2, art. 1 (ss 42-2-101 through 42-2-114); the chapter continues through art. 2 Employment and Training Program, art. 3 Telephone Assistance Program, art. 4 Medicaid Eligibility and art. 5 Energy Assistance
verified_how: walked the LSO NXT table of contents (gateway.dll?f=xmlcontents&command=getchildren) down to 'TITLE 42 - WELFARE' > 'CHAPTER 2 - PUBLIC ASSISTANCE AND SOCIAL SERVICES' and its five articles; article 1 runs from '42-2-101. Short title.' and '42-2-102. Definitions.' to '42-2-114. Reimbursement of federal government.'. Repealed sections are shown in the same listing with a 'Repealed by Laws ...' catchline (e.g. '37-3-103. Repealed by Laws 1995, ch. 192, s 3.'), so the substantive catchlines above are live text. Currency: the LSO's Statutes Download page states 'This version of the Wyoming Statutes contains changes from the 2026 Budget Session and reflects the contents of the statutes as they exist as of July 1, 2026'; the NXT infobase I browsed is the one labelled '2026 Wyoming Statutes' (the register also keeps 2020-2025 as separate historical infobases). Official title PDF at https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title42.pdf.
notes: Wyoming's public assistance statute (state assistance programmes, eligibility and administration by the Department of Family Services). Unemployment insurance is a separate and substantial statute in Title 27 - Chapter 3, Unemployment Compensation, whose eight articles (In General, Fund Administration, Benefits, Benefit Claims, Employer Contributions, Administration, Penalties, Short Time Compensation Program) were confirmed on the register in the same session; encode it separately if the corpus wants unemployment as its own subject.
